title: Origin story: Vowkeeper
description: Vowkeeper was a notary who witnessed ten thousand oaths and never spoke of one — until the day a tyrant demanded she reveal a rebel's vow. She refused, and the tyrant cut out her tongue. She witnesses still, in silence, and her seal on an oath makes it unbreakable. She needs no tongue; the seal speaks.
